description: Clicks on the website's phone, WhatsApp and email links (header bar, below the forms), counted per kind, ad platform and campaign (utm_campaign), with the spot on the page. Anonymous: no click id, no person — a click is interest, not a lead. Default: last 30 days. Besides the contact kinds (telefon, whatsapp, email) the landing pages also count the steps before, once per page view each: besuch (page loaded), verweilt (stayed 20 s with the tab visible), scroll (half the page), video (played), cta (main button), formular (form started), chat (chat widget), demo (header demo button) — read them as a funnel per campaign. With `calls` (inbound calls, e.g. from acb__list_calls: [{id, at}] with at = created_at) each call is matched to a phone click: 'eindeutig' only if exactly one phone click lies up to 120 s before it and that click is not the only candidate of another call; several candidates → 'unklar'; none → 'ohne_klick'. Report 'unklar' as unclear, never guess a campaign for it.

art.description: Only clicks or funnel steps of this kind

calls.description: Inbound calls to match: [{id, at}] (at = ISO time the call started), max 500.
